title: hare-and-tortoise-race
style: Pixar-style 3D animation, rich lighting, expressive anthropomorphic woodland characters, warm storybook color palette

characters.name: Hare
characters.identity_spec: anthropomorphic hare, tall and wiry athletic build, sandy brown fur with lighter cream muzzle and belly, long upright ears with pink inner ears, sharp green eyes, expressive cocky grin, oversized hind paws, wearing a neon-green sweatband, slim red running shorts, and a small shiny gold wristwatch

characters.name: Tortoise
characters.identity_spec: anthropomorphic tortoise, short and sturdy body, olive-green skin, large dark green domed shell with golden hexagonal scute pattern, gentle brown eyes behind round silver spectacles, wrinkled kind face, short thick legs, wearing a small sky-blue neckerchief

characters.name: Fox
characters.identity_spec: anthropomorphic fox, medium height and lean build, orange-red fur, white chest and muzzle, sharp amber eyes, bushy tail with white tip, wearing a tidy black vest, small bow tie, and carrying a small betting ledger

characters.name: Squirrel
characters.identity_spec: anthropomorphic squirrel, small energetic body, reddish-brown fur, cream belly, bright black eyes, huge curled fluffy tail, wearing a tiny referee cap and holding a black-and-white checkered flag

characters.name: Forest Animals
characters.identity_spec: group of varied anthropomorphic woodland animals including rabbits, hedgehogs, birds, deer, mice, and chipmunks, colorful small outfits, rounded expressive faces, arranged as a lively cheering crowd

scenes.title: The Callout
scenes.setting: edge of the Old Oak Forest, massive oak trunks, mossy roots, scattered wildflowers, morning sunlight filtering through leaves
scenes.action: Hare bounces on his toes and mocks Tortoise while Tortoise adjusts his spectacles and calmly proposes a five-mile race to the Ancient Willow. Forest animals gasp as Fox prepares odds in his ledger.
scenes.emotion: public challenge, smug teasing against quiet confidence and crowd surprise
scenes.camera: medium wide shot at eye level, Hare and Tortoise centered with crowd behind them

scenes.title: The Explosive Start
scenes.setting: forest starting line marked in packed dirt, checkered banner between two posts, dusty path stretching into the distance
scenes.action: Squirrel drops the checkered flag. Hare launches forward in a blur and kicks up a dust cloud while Tortoise coughs softly and takes his first deliberate step.
scenes.emotion: explosive speed contrasted with patient resolve
scenes.camera: low-angle wide shot tracking along the race path from the starting line

scenes.title: The Mid-Race Hubris
scenes.setting: sunny clover patch at the halfway mark beneath a shady elm tree, soft grass, clover blossoms, warm midday light
scenes.action: Hare checks his pulse, looks back at the empty path, yawns with overconfidence, then curls up under the elm for a short nap.
scenes.emotion: smug ease turning into sleepy carelessness
scenes.camera: medium shot from a slight high angle, framing Hare beside the clover patch

scenes.title: The Grind
scenes.setting: dusty forest path near the halfway point, sun lower in the sky, sleeping Hare under a nearby elm, Ancient Willow direction ahead
scenes.action: Tortoise sweats and trudges past the sleeping Hare without stopping, keeping his eyes fixed ahead on the path to the Ancient Willow.
scenes.camera: side-on tracking medium wide shot, Tortoise moving foreground while Hare sleeps in background

scenes.title: The Rude Awakening
scenes.setting: beneath the elm tree, long afternoon shadows stretching across the path toward the distant Ancient Willow
scenes.action: Hare bolts upright, checks his gold watch in panic, then spots Tortoise as a small dark shape close to the finish line.
scenes.camera: medium close-up on Hare with a shallow view down the path behind him

scenes.title: The Photo Finish
scenes.setting: finish line beneath the huge Ancient Willow, painted line across dirt path, crowd gathered around roots, golden late-afternoon light
scenes.action: Hare sprints desperately toward the finish while Tortoise stretches his neck forward and crosses the line just before Hare reaches him. The forest animals react in shock and excitement.
scenes.emotion: desperate sprint, painful effort, sudden victory
scenes.camera: dramatic low-angle wide shot at the finish line, Tortoise foreground and Hare closing in behind
